identity.name: Royal Palm Yacht & Country Club
identity.notes: A prestigious ~450-acre gated country-club community in Boca Raton, FL, with ~742 lots and ~680 homes. Features waterfront, golf-course, and interior lots. Homes range from 3-7 bedrooms, 2,240–11,471 sq ft. Median sold price rose from $3.4M (2017) to ~$9M (2026). The community includes an optional private club with yacht club, marina, golf, tennis, and country club amenities. 24/7 armed security and guarded entrances.

fees.note: Approximately $4,150 per lot, paid July 1. No historical special assessments noted. Exact fees may vary by lot type; verify with RPIA directly. Club membership is optional and separate from HOA dues.
Reported as monthly equivalent of the annual HOA dues. Covers community services and reserves.

amenities.detail: Limited-access community with 24/7 armed security patrols and guarded entrances.
Golf course on the community grounds; part of the private club amenities.
Five tennis courts plus a sports court, described as active areas for play.
Renovated pool with saline chlorination system (softer water, less irritation), gazebo, shallow wading pool for toddlers, and water features.
Recently remodeled venue with member dining, flexible event spaces (4 to ~400 guests), two meeting spaces, wine room with sampling area, terrace dining, and fire pit. Views of marina.
Private marina on the community waterfront.
Clubhouse with dining and social spaces.
Fitness and wellness facility with fitness team offering programs including water aerobics.
Outdoor entertainment space on the club campus.

Dedicated kids' space in the Yacht Club with hand-painted Florida wildlife mural, chalkboard wall, gaming stations, dedicated restroom, and S.T.E.A.M. program activities led by a Youth Activities Director.
Jack Nicklaus Signature Golf Course within the community; the featured residence has 92 ft of golf course frontage overlooking the 10th tee. Retrieved 2025-06-18T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.9.
